build_rational_entity: build a rational agent prefab that optimizes for a given goal using a language model and memory bank
create_entity_with_goal: create an Entity prefab with a custom goal and name for goal-oriented agent behavior
configure_entity_params: configure Entity params to set name, goal, randomize_choices, and prefix_entity_name options
build_entity_with_logging: build an EntityAgentWithLogging instance by calling Entity.build with a model and memory bank
review_entity_components: review the Entity prefab components including memory, instructions, observation, situation perception, and best option perception
